title: Non defect-stabilized thermally stable single-atom catalyst
research_question: Can Fe2O3 stabilize high concentrations of isolated Pt and improve methane combustion?
supported_finding: At 700 C methane conversion increased from about 18% to 65% over four hours as Pt nanoparticles converted toward isolated Pt.
conditions_that_matter: 0.5 vol% CH4; 3 vol% O2; He balance; 30 mL min-1; 300-700 C then hold at 700 C.
limitation: Clusters emerge at >=2 wt% Pt; estimated capacity near 1.5 wt% for 10 m2 g-1 Fe2O3 (p. 4).
discussion_question_1: Is post-reaction Pt1 evidence sufficient without operando proof?
discussion_question_2: Is redispersion synthesis, activation, or both?

title: Breaking the scaling relationship via thermally stable Pt/Cu single atom alloys for catalytic dehydrogenation
research_question: Can isolated Pt in Cu improve propane-dehydrogenation selectivity and stability above 500 C?
supported_finding: About 90% propylene selectivity and 10.6 mol gPt-1 h-1 at 520 C; isolated Pt signature retained after 120 h.
conditions_that_matter: Figure 5 caption (p. 6): atmospheric pressure; propane WHSV 4 h-1; 250 mg; C3H8/H2=1/1; balance N2; 50 mL min-1 total. Conflicting p. 2 summary: C3H8/N2=1/1.
limitation: Cu sintering and rapid deactivation at 600 C; regenerated-catalyst EXAFS absent. The p. 2 and p. 6 feed descriptions conflict.
discussion_question_1: Which measurement most strongly ties selectivity to isolated Pt?
discussion_question_2: How should the feed conflict affect reproducibility and confidence?

title: Directing reaction pathways via in situ control of active site geometries in PdAu single-atom alloy catalysts
research_question: Can CO coverage reversibly switch Pd ensemble size and redirect ethanol dehydrogenation?
supported_finding: SAA gave <20% conversion and 100% acetaldehyde/H2 selectivity to 300 C; clusters raised conversion to up to 90% but formed byproducts.
conditions_that_matter: 300 mg; 2 wt% ethanol/He; 12 mL min-1; GHSV 2400 mL h-1 gcat-1; 2 h per temperature.
limitation: Clusters redisperse; repeated switching builds carbon; model shifts DFT CO energy by +0.2 eV.
discussion_question_1: Why is within-sample switching stronger than separate comparisons?
discussion_question_2: How should mechanism be assigned when ensemble size changes?

title: Building up libraries and production line for single atom catalysts with precursor-atomization strategy
research_question: Can precursor atomization produce SACs above kilogram-per-day scale with uniform structure and function?
supported_finding: Line exceeded 1 kg day-1; four sampled batches showed similar structure and catalytic TOFs.
pdf_locator: Production description p. 3; Fig. 4 p. 6; reproducibility discussion p. 5; Fig. 5d-f p. 7
conditions_that_matter: 120 g m-2 FeOx; belt about 1 cm min-1; precursor about 40 mL h-1; calcination 400 C for 2 h; coupling at 40 C.
limitation: Detailed uniformity uses four about 10 g samples and one reaction family; separate calcination and 100% dispersion assumption remain.
discussion_question_1: What sampling validates a uniform 1 kg day-1 product?

title: Highly selective and robust single-atom catalyst Ru1/NC for reductive amination of aldehydes/ketones
research_question: Can Ru-N coordination tune hydrogen activation for selective primary-amine synthesis?
supported_finding: 97% furfurylamine yield and 170.7 gFAM gRu-1 h-1 versus 53% for RuNP-1000.
conditions_that_matter: 2 mmol furfural; Ru:furfural=1:400; 3 g methanol; 0.5 MPa NH3; 2 MPa H2; 100 C; 10 h.
limitation: EXAFS CN uncertainty +/-20%; indirect mechanism; batch test is not scale-up evidence.
discussion_question_1: Are coordination and electronic effects isolated?
